# FadeShed

> FadeShed is Fade78's open software workshop: practical tools for agentic workflows, developer tooling, and collaboration between people and software.

The projects are independent and solve different problems. FileShed performs work inside Open WebUI; Pasteberth stages and exchanges artifacts across working contexts; LightWebPres publishes Markdown as readable pages and presentations. Agent-oriented does not mean agent-only, and no interface is reserved for a particular type of participant.

Project status is explicit: **FileShed — Retired; Pasteberth — Beta; LightWebPres — Beta.** Retirement does not erase the code or imply complete equivalence with a successor. Beta is not a production-support or compatibility guarantee. Use each project's more specific `llms.txt` and the documentation matching the selected release or source revision.

## Choose a project

- [FileShed](https://fadeshed.github.io/fileshed/llms.txt): Open WebUI workbench for approved command execution, data pipelines, document and media transformations, precise edits, Git-versioned documents, group collaboration and authenticated deliverables. Retired when OpenTerminal covered much of the author's own workflow.
- [Pasteberth](https://fadeshed.github.io/pasteberth/llms.txt): Self-hosted artifact staging through Web, filesystem, CLI and programmatic interfaces. Includes clipboard reuse, arbitrary allowed files, local registration without network transfer, and automatically discovered project zones. Beta.
- [LightWebPres](https://fadeshed.github.io/lightwebpres/llms.txt): Markdown-to-HTML publishing with portrait reading, landscape navigation, long-form content, themes, presentation presets, identity kits, a CLI and a browser builder. Beta.

## Read the overviews

- [FadeShed](https://fadeshed.github.io/index.md): workshop purpose, product relationships and status.
- [FileShed workbench](https://fadeshed.github.io/fileshed/overview.md): capabilities, workspace model, historical workflow and source boundaries.
- [Pasteberth staging model](https://fadeshed.github.io/pasteberth/index.md): artifacts, zones, participants, retrieval paths and limits.
- [LightWebPres publishing model](https://fadeshed.github.io/lightwebpres/index.md): source, output, authoring interfaces, agent use and trust boundaries.
